name: lvgl

checks: GitHub Releases API lists v9.6.0 as the newest non-prerelease v9 release (previous: v9.5.0, 2026-02-18).
The downloaded archive's include/lvgl/lv_version.h defines LVGL_VERSION_MAJOR 9 / MINOR 6 / PATCH 0 / INFO "".
The archive's LICENCE.txt is the MIT licence, copyright LVGL Kft.
The archive's SHA-256 was computed locally from the downloaded bytes, not copied from a web page.

import.status: fetched at build time (Tranche 1), never vendored in the repository
import.build_option: CRTUI_ENABLE_LVGL (default OFF); crtui's own configuration is libcrtui/src/lvgl_conf/lv_conf.h
notes: Tranche 1 imports LVGL privately: tools/fetch_lvgl.py downloads the archive, verifies size, SHA-256 and the commit recorded in the archive's pax header, and extracts only the paths above (28 MB of the 111 MB archive, which also carries tests/, docs/, examples/ and demos/). Nothing is committed to the repository.

The archive hash is of GitHub's generated tarball as observed on 2026-09-30. GitHub can regenerate archives, so expected_commit is the authoritative pin; if the archive hash ever differs for the same commit, re-derive it and update this file rather than trusting either blindly.

Do not patch LVGL's own source to make a build error go away. A build failure first means a missing CRT/PAL/C runtime surface (AGENTS.md porting loop); only build-configuration edits (lv_conf.h) belong in patches.

public_api_policy: LVGL is a private implementation dependency of libcrtui. No lv_* type, macro or header appears in any installed crtui header.
tools/verify_dist.py (stage 05-ui and later) fails if include/lvgl, include/lvgl.h or include/lv_conf.h appear in the distribution.
LVGL's own GPU backends stay disabled; rendering goes through its software draw buffer into the existing crtgfx present path.
